name: cl_Ag55
title: Ag55 cluster
description: Gas-phase Ag55. The Mackay icosahedron is the GM for many-body potentials (Cambridge Cluster Database) and is supported by DFT and photoelectron spectra of Ag55- (Haekkinen et al., PRL 93, 093401 (2004)). NEP89 reproduces it, about 2 eV below the cuboctahedron and Ino decahedron; the difficulty is the size of the landscape rather than near-degenerate competitors.
